headline: Verizon in Talks to Acquire Fidium for $6 Billion
summary: Verizon Communications is in advanced talks to acquire broadband operator Fidium in a deal valuing the company at approximately $6 billion including debt, according to reports.
why: Verizon is one of the largest telecommunications and wireless service providers in the United States. Acquisitions of broadband operators expand its fiber and fixed-line network reach.

impacts.name: Verizon Communications Inc.
impacts.why: Verizon is reportedly negotiating the purchase of Fidium for $6 billion including debt.
